headline: Identifying the Subtle Signs of a Hidden Plumbing Leak
articleBody: Not all leaks announce themselves with a dramatic burst; many start subtly, hidden behind walls or under floors, slowly causing damage before you even notice. One key sign to watch for is an unexplained increase in your water bill, even if your usage hasn't changed. That's often the first clue. Another indicator is the appearance of mysterious damp spots or discoloration on ceilings, walls, or floors – these can signal water seeping through. You might also notice a musty odor, even if you can't see the water source, which points to hidden mold or mildew growth from a persistent leak. Listen closely for the sound of dripping or running water when no faucets are on or appliances are in use. Finally, keep an eye on your water meter; if it's still moving when all water sources are turned off, you likely have a leak somewhere.
